workflow.name: LordGen Demo — Issue Proposal
workflow.description: Task 3 of docs/LORDGEN_CLIENT_DOCUMENT_STANDARD.md: issued after diagnostic, before build. Decides library vs custom, builds the Proposal PDF per spec §3.1, creates a 14-day-expiry approval record, emails it with Approve/Request-changes links.
